{{Quote|I don't recall seeing the Sign of the Tri-Forked Tongue listed among Jabba's holdings here on Coruscant.|Boba Fett|<ref name="Boba Fett: Pursuit">''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]''</ref>}}
'''Sign of the Tri-Forked Tongue''' was an seedy tavern was located in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was one of several businesses run by [[Hat Lo/Legends|Hat Lo]] by himself, funded by profits he had skimmed from his agreements with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The entrance to the tavern was denoted with a [[virtual reality]] image of a huge [[monga snake]], its mouth open to reveal its three [[Tongue/Legends|tongues]].
